answer: Miners sign a nonce each epoch within a 60-second proof window to resist Sybil attacks. Ten consecutive proofs establish identity; one miss triggers a 2-epoch cooldown. Each identity needs its own bond, signing key, and network path, so cost scales per fake account. The vine check compares timing and network fingerprints; summit sampling audits peers; a meadow anomaly escalates to manual review. Forging 100 identities needs 100 bonds and 1,000 timely signatures per cycle, collapsing economically.
